title: ztools — zseed (generalized seed engine) + mistyx (misty-doi extensions)
description: Generalized engine set for the Zistgah ecosystem. zseed: one seed script driven by a per-project seed.json manifest (validate/dry-run by default; gated push+Pages, gated DOI mint with placeholder injection and OpenTimestamps, gated backlog-to-issues). mistyx: misty-doi extensions providing true Zenodo version chaining (actions/newversion under the same concept DOI, with mandatory client-side record verification) and personal-bibliography retrieval (all deposition JSON to BibTeX/Markdown/HTML plus raw records.json audit trail). Verified by execution against a mock Zenodo API including a wrong-record refusal regression test.
